tools.description:
Look up the current status of a print job (submitted, approved, printing, QC,
    shipped) and its UPS tracking number once shipped. Use when the user asks about
    an order they placed with HardCopy Labs.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "submit_print_job" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
